hooks.command:
d=$(cat)
cmd=$(printf '%s' "$d" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')
case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac

# 커맨드 전체가 아니라 첫 git commit 이후만 본다. 앞쪽에 파일을 쓰는 코드가 있으면
# 그 내용에 trailer 문자열이 들어 있을 수 있고, 그건 커밋 메시지가 아니다.
msg=${cmd#*git commit}

if printf '%s' "$msg" | grep -qiE 'co-authored-by:[[:space:]]*claude|claude-session:|generated with .{0,6}claude code'; then
  echo "커밋 메시지에 Claude 서명이 있습니다. CLAUDE.md 규칙이므로 해당 trailer 를 지우고 다시 실행하세요." >&2
  exit 2
fi

wd=$(printf '%s' "$d" | jq -r '.cwd // "."')
bad=$(git -C "$wd" diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null \
      | grep -E '(^|/)\.env($|\.)|(^|/)(node_modules|\.build|DerivedData|__pycache__)/|\.pyc$' \
      | grep -vE '(^|/)\.env\.(example|sample|template|dist)$' || true)
if [ -n "$bad" ]; then
  echo "커밋 금지 대상이 스테이징돼 있습니다. git restore --staged 로 빼고 다시 실행하세요:" >&2
  printf '%s\n' "$bad" >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0

hooks.prompt:
Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

FIRST, check tool_input.command in the hook input above. If it does NOT contain the substring 'git commit', a commit was not made — reply only 'ok' and do nothing else (this is success, not an error).

Otherwise, a git commit was just made. Review the committed changes by running `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD` and `git log -1 --format='%s%n%n%b'`. Check for:
1. Conventional Commits format compliance (type(scope): description)
2. Atomic commit principle (one logical change per commit)
3. Code quality issues (typos, debug code, TODO/FIXME left behind, trailing whitespace)
4. Potential bugs or logic errors in the diff
5. Security concerns (hardcoded secrets, credentials)
6. No Claude or Anthropic co-author trailers or signatures in the message

Provide a brief review summary. If everything looks good, say so concisely. If there are issues, list them clearly with file and line references. Keep the review short and actionable.
